classifications.authority_or_basis: USDKG official material identifies OJSC Virtual Asset Issuer as a state-owned issuer under the Kyrgyz Ministry of Finance and describes USDKG as a gold-backed virtual asset; registry v3 leaves the legal classification unclassified rather than inventing a fiat-stablecoin category.

notes: State-owned issuer and gold backing are established; exact holder legal claim, reserve ownership, segregation and insolvency treatment remain unresolved.

classifications.authority_or_basis: AllUnity identifies EURAU as a fully reserved MiCAR-compliant euro electronic-money token issued under a BaFin EMI licence.

notes: Par issuance/redemption and fully reserved status are established; detailed insolvency treatment remains source-bounded.

classifications.authority_or_basis: Banking Circle identifies EURI as a MiCA-compliant electronic-money token issued and backed by Banking Circle S.A.

notes: Banking Circle states 1:1 cash backing in safeguarded segregated funds; insolvency treatment beyond that wording is not inferred.
